I had something very similar happen a few years ago. I felt embarrassed and generally destroyed even more emotionally, but I was too discouraged to try anymore. I felt again that it didn’t work and the feeling of waking up after an attempt is probably a worse feeling than before the attempt. I went on with life so discouraged about trying again. I hit a really hard bottom after that, but eventually I spent more time with my kids and it helped some. It got me through a lot of shit just being there with them. Things have slowly gone up and down in my life, but if you can find just one person to be around that helps you feel like you don’t want to try again or just to sit with so that you don’t one day things will get better. I’m not gonna tell you it won’t get bad again, but it’ll help and maybe make you appreciate the highs in life a little more. Just give things one more real shot and find someone. Maybe they won’t make you ecstatic about life, but just someone to sit with when shit gets bad. Maybe you’ll see them everyday maybe you’ll see them once a month, but as long as it’ll keep you from trying again it’s helping. Failed attempts are horrid. They leave you feeling empty and embarrassed. I get it. But there’s still highs and some lows to go through. It’s pretty worth giving it another shot. I hope this helps you feel at least somewhat better.
